summary.ko: 원문·번역·화면 제약을 비교해 누락·용어·변수·레이아웃 위험을 검수합니다.
summary.en: Compare source and localized content for meaning, terminology, placeholders, and interface constraints.

exclusions: Creating an entire translation from scratch
Subtitle files requiring cue and timing preservation

required_inputs.description: Aligned source and target content with identifiers
Target locale, glossary, placeholders, and UI limits or screenshots

workflow.instruction: Align source and target IDs and detect missing, duplicated, untranslated, or mismatched strings.
Check meaning, terminology, tone, locale formats, plurals, gender handling, and cultural clarity.
Validate placeholders, markup, escapes, accelerators, and length-sensitive contexts without altering functional tokens.
Return prioritized corrections with source evidence and identify issues requiring an in-app visual or linguistic review.

deliverables.name: Localization defect log
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Each issue has string ID, category, severity rationale, evidence, and suggested correction

deliverables.name: Corrected strings
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Preserves keys, placeholders, and expected serialization

limitations: String length alone does not prove visual truncation.
Do not certify all locales from review of one language pair.
permission_boundaries: Do not push translations to production, modify locale settings, or upload string bundles externally.
Do not expose hidden or confidential product strings in public examples.
